boundary: A reconstruction reads only its own source PNGs and source poses. A separate renderer reads frozen checkpoint and allowed poses. Reference truth is private evaluation data.

capture.camera: OpenCV x-right y-down z-forward, optical-axis camera Z in metres, integer pixels; gsplat K principal point +0.5.
capture.colour: Blender Cycles Standard, no Look, exposure 0 gamma 1 sRGB. EXR linear combined to FP32 display-sRGB before 8-bit source encoding.

cohort.engineering_pilot: first two training worlds only; distinct marked run identities; production scientific run uses frozen budget

display: v01 fixed. Six target identifiers, all six and possible failures retained in evaluation.

hypotheses.prediction: At fixed endpoint span, M4 may reduce family-wise target RGB error relative to M2 by resolving ambiguous layers.
hypotheses.refutation: Nonnegative M4-minus-M2 RGB incidence or MAE in the four-family macro comparison.

hypotheses.prediction: Thin near-field occupiers can remain erroneous despite extra middle sources.
hypotheses.refutation: No residual edge or disoccluded errors in registered heldout evaluations.

hypotheses.prediction: Additional images under an equal total update budget may impair some well-observed surfaces.
hypotheses.refutation: Every family improves for all registered RGB-error outcomes.

test_gate: Before registered joint reconstruction and risk freeze, the test entrance cannot instantiate a test world, render test truth, create a test job, or resolve selected test data.
visibility: Per-source Blender opaque first-hit with 0 invalid/background 1 observed 2 disoccluded 3 outside; retain reason and first hit ID. Edge is object/surface boundary dilated by two pixels, independent of source count.
